Loans, net of unearned income, represented 60 percent of interest-earning assets at December 31, 2021, down from 64 percent at December 31, 2020, a decline of 4 percentage points [2]. In its fiscal 2021 10-K, Regions organizes lending along three portfolio segments [2]:
- **Commercial**: commercial and industrial loans, plus owner-occupied commercial real estate mortgage and construction loans.
- **Investor real estate**: commercial real estate mortgage and construction loans.
- **Consumer**: residential first mortgage, home equity lines and loans, consumer credit card, other consumer—exit portfolios, and other consumer loans.
